title: PlayerWarn
description: PlayerWarn is a client-side Fabric mod that notifies you with a chat message and sound when a player enters your render distance, with an ignore list configurable via /playeralert.
body:
PlayerWarn is a **lightweight**, **client-side** Fabric mod that helps you stay aware of nearby players. Whenever another player enters your render distance, the mod notifies you with a chat message and a sound alert. This is especially useful for survival, PvP, and anarchy servers where awareness is crucial.
You can manage an ignore list using the **/playeralert command** to prevent alerts for specific player names. The mod runs entirely on the client and does not require any server-side installation.
